packetSummary: All 40 items have exactly one defensible option among those offered; no item has zero or multiple correct options. Main issues: every item is labelled medium, yet about 12 are clearly easy (001, 002, 004, 006, 015, 018, 024, 026, 035, 036, 037) and two lean hard (016, 031). nr-004 is the textbook Fibonacci sequence and should be replaced. nr-013 has a competing rule (2b-1) that fits the given rows and yields 11 (not offered), which may confuse students. nr-032/036 should define the AB / 4A digit notation, nr-039 needs the triangle structure stated or drawn, and nr-023 needs $ units on options. The packet is internally repetitive: four constant-sum grids, two 2a+b grids, two add-previous-two sequences, two interleaved sequences and two assume-all word problems.
